description: (needs account token) Attaches a domain registered at another registrar to a site. Nothing is transferred or bought. The reply includes the one A record to set at that registrar. On a site that already has a domain, the name is an extra that redirects (301) to the main one. A repeat with the same domain re-checks whether the name points here. Does not charge.

site.description: The address of a site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.
